item.title: Volkswagen started blocking GrapheneOS users
item.description:
📝 You should be aware that modern cars carry a cellular modem and report extensive telemetry to the manufacturer, dealer, and possibly third parties. Cars can also be effectively remote controlled because of it. By connecting a phone to the car, you are just adding another exfiltration mechanism, and are allowing data to be exfiltrated even if you disabled or removed the cellular modem from the car.
🔗 Read more: https://discuss.grapheneos.org/d/35949-volkswagen-app?page=3
